code-samples.code:
curl -X PUT "https://app.anodot.com/api/v2/bc/data-streams/{data-stream-id}" \
-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
-d "{stream json from GET request}"

The requested file name should appear as the filename parameter

curl -X POST "https://app.anodot.com/api/v2/lookup/data?filename=mylookup.csv" \
-H 'Content-Type: text/csv' \
-H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
--data-binary '@/Users/myuser/filesforAnodot/mylookup.csv'
